ala1.personality: Paranoid, obsessive, methodical. He sees threats everywhere — because he's seen real ones.
ala1.motivation: Protect the Falcons' surveillance network. Anyone who approaches is a potential spy.
ala1.backstory: A former sharpshooter recruited by Alanossa after he took down three infiltrators in one night. He's never left his post since — literally. He sleeps in his watch chair. Recruits say he never blinks.
ala1.combatMechanic: Predicts your attacks: auto-dodges every 3 turns. Must be struck while reloading.
ala1.specialAbility: Preemptive strike — attacks first every turn, ignores defensive stance.
ala1.enemyDesc: He's been watching for so long he doesn't know how to do anything else.

ala2.personality: Calculating, cold, indispensable. He knows the Falcons collapse without him.
ala2.motivation: Control the supply chains. Power isn't weapons — it's logistics.
ala2.backstory: A former smuggler recruited by Alanossa to organize her logistics. He made the Falcons self-sufficient in a year. He knows every route, every cache, every debt. Killing him would be easy. Replacing him, impossible.
ala2.combatMechanic: Uses support drones that repair his armor. The drones must be destroyed first (3 drones, 40 HP each).
ala2.specialAbility: Call for reinforcements — summons a drone that absorbs the next hit.
ala2.enemyDesc: Without him the faction collapses. He knows it.

ala3.personality: Silent, lethal, loyal unto death. He's the armed fist Alanossa uses when words no longer suffice.
ala3.motivation: Carry out Alanossa's orders without question. His devotion is absolute.
ala3.backstory: No one knows his real name. Alanossa found him in the ruins of Station Quarantaine — sole survivor of an epidemic that killed three hundred people. She took him in, trained him, forged him. He became her shadow.
ala3.combatMechanic: Invisible on odd turns — can't be hit. Automatically counter-attacks when you miss.
ala3.specialAbility: Ghost strike — guaranteed critical hit from invisibility.
ala3.enemyDesc: You see him only once. Usually it's too late.

ala4.personality: Charismatic, ruthless, pragmatic. She inspires loyalty through both fear AND respect.
ala4.motivation: Become Alanossa's right hand. She's the only one who could replace her — and they both know it.
ala4.backstory: A former military officer who deserted after watching her commander sacrifice an entire regiment to save his career. Alanossa offered her something the army never had: justice. Now she runs the Nest with iron discipline.
ala4.combatMechanic: Switches stance every 2 turns: offensive (×1.5 damage) or defensive (÷2 damage taken). You have to adapt.
ala4.specialAbility: Command — gains +5% cumulative damage each turn.
ala4.enemyDesc: Chief of the Black Falcons. Calculating. Relentless.

ces1.personality: Smiling, poisonous, dangerous. She sells with a smile. What she sells always kills.
ces1.motivation: Profit. Pure and simple. Cesarion lets her keep Comptoir Sud in exchange for a cut. And information.
ces1.backstory: Daughter of merchants assassinated by pirates. She rebuilt the family empire selling the same weapons that killed her parents — to the same people. "Business has no morals," she says. She genuinely believes it.
ces1.combatMechanic: Poisons her weapons — every hit inflicts stacking poison. The longer the fight, the more dangerous it gets.
ces1.specialAbility: Commercial poison — every turn, the player loses 5 extra HP (stacking).
ces1.enemyDesc: What she sells always kills, even the insurance policies.

ces2.personality: Brutal, territorial, possessive. Everything that passes through his relay belongs to him.
ces2.motivation: Control the flow of goods for Cesarion. He taxes everything — official or not.
ces2.backstory: A former customs officer turned logistics warlord. Cesarion recruited him because he was the only one who understood how to tax without killing trade. His efficiency has a price: regular disappearances of "noncompliant" merchants.
ces2.combatMechanic: Steals your credits on every successful hit (5% of your credits per strike). A fight against the clock.
ces2.specialAbility: Blood tax — every successful attack costs you credits.
ces2.enemyDesc: He controls Relais de Transit. Everything that passes through, he taxes.

ces3.personality: Methodical, invisible, omniscient within his domain. He knows everything that comes in and goes out.
ces3.motivation: Hold information. To Cesarion, he's more valuable than a hundred soldiers.
ces3.backstory: No one knows his face — he's worn a mask since arriving at the Warehouse. Some say he's a former spy, others an ex-convict. What's certain: he knows all the Emporium's secrets. Cesarion keeps him alive because he can't be replaced.
ces3.combatMechanic: Knows your gear — reduces your weapon's effectiveness by 30%. Switching weapons mid-fight throws him off.
ces3.specialAbility: Tactical analysis — dodges the first hit of every sequence and counter-attacks.
ces3.enemyDesc: He knows all the secrets. He buries the rest.

ces4.personality: Elusive, diplomatic on the surface, ruthless in the shadows. The man behind the man.
ces4.motivation: Be Cesarion's closest advisor. He pulls the strings from the Annex, out of sight.
ces4.backstory: A former diplomat of a vanished nation. He watched his world collapse and swore never to be on the losing side again. Cesarion uses him as an interface with the outside world — a friendly face for brutal decisions.
ces4.combatMechanic: Has personal guards (2 guards, 60 HP each) who must be eliminated first. He heals himself as long as a guard is alive.
ces4.specialAbility: Ghost directive — heals 15 HP/turn as long as a guard is alive.
ces4.enemyDesc: Officially a bureaucrat. Unofficially, a ghost.

raph1.personality: Broken, methodical, haunted. He still obeys orders given forty years ago.
raph1.motivation: Carry out Raphazarus's last directive: watch over Les Cendres and eliminate anyone who asks questions about L'Arc Perdu.
raph1.backstory: Last survivor of Raphazarus's 3rd Battalion. He watched his comrades die one by one during the Siege of Les Cendres — 47 days without resupply. When rescue arrived, he was the only one standing. Raphazarus shook his hand and said: "You stay here. You wait." He's still waiting.
raph1.combatMechanic: Fights with relentless military discipline: always attacks twice in a row, but pauses one turn every 4 turns to "reload".
raph1.specialAbility: Firing cadence — double attack every turn, pauses every 4 turns.
raph1.enemyDesc: He's been waiting for forty years. He has all the time in the world.

raph2.personality: Cold, surgical, devoted beyond reason. Her husband died under Raphazarus's orders — and she's grateful to him for it.
raph2.motivation: Protect La Forteresse Exilée, Raphazarus's last known outpost before his disappearance. She holds information on the location of L'Arc Perdu.
raph2.backstory: Her husband commanded Raphazarus's elite fleet. He died covering the General's retreat to L'Arc Perdu. Instead of hating him for it, she swore eternal allegiance. "My husband chose to die for him. That choice deserves to be honored." She's become the most relentless guardian of all the veterans — the only one Raphazarus still occasionally contacts.
raph2.combatMechanic: Wears mourning armor that absorbs 40% of physical damage. Energy weapons (burn, shock) ignore this reduction.
raph2.specialAbility: Mourning armor — reduces physical damage by 40%, vulnerable to energy weapons.
raph2.enemyDesc: Her husband died for Raphazarus. She'll live for him.

raph3.personality: Invisible, silent, terrifying. He might not even be human anymore — no one's sure.
raph3.motivation: Eliminate anyone who gets close to the truth about L'Arc Perdu. Raphazarus gave him a mission: make sure no one can ever find it. Ever.
raph3.backstory: Former head of military intelligence for Raphazarus's 7th Corps. After the Great War, he erased every trace of L'Arc Perdu from official archives — coordinates, manifests, navigation logs. Then he erased himself. Station Fantôme bears his name: no one knows if he really lives there or if he's everywhere at once.
raph3.combatMechanic: Alternates between two phases: visible (attacks normally) and spectral (immune to physical attacks, can only be hit by effects/special weapons). Switches phase every 2 turns.
raph3.specialAbility: Spectral phase — immune to direct attacks every 2 turns.
raph3.enemyDesc: Head of intelligence. He erased L'Arc Perdu from the maps.

raph4.personality: Stoic, ruthless, respected even by Raphazarus's enemies. The last officer still active.
raph4.motivation: Keep La Forge des Damnés operational — this is where Raphazarus forges his weapons and trains his last loyal soldiers. The Marshal is the last line of defense before the General.
raph4.backstory: Raphazarus's right hand since before the Great War. He survived three assassination attempts, two betrayals, and an orbital bombardment. His nickname comes from his injuries: he's had so many fractures heal back together that his bones form natural armor. Raphazarus named him guardian of the Forge because he's the one man he trusts absolutely.
raph4.combatMechanic: His reinforced bones reduce critical damage by 60%. The more you hit him, the angrier he gets — +15% damage per 25% HP lost.
raph4.specialAbility: Armored bone structure — reduces criticals by 60%, growing rage (+15% damage/25% HP lost).
raph4.enemyDesc: Raphazarus's last officer. Three failed assassinations. Two betrayals survived. One orbital bombardment.

sco1.personality: Discreet, patient, deadly. He runs Port de Nuit from the shadows — no one ever sees him.
sco1.motivation: Control the black market for Scotty. Port de Nuit is his kingdom.
sco1.backstory: A former orphan from the Bas-Fonds. Scotty spotted him when he was twelve — he already had his own thief network. Scotty gave him Port de Nuit as a playground. He turned it into an empire.
sco1.combatMechanic: Fights in darkness — your attacks deal 30% less damage unless you use a weapon with a "burn" or "blind" effect.
sco1.specialAbility: Night shadow — your attacks are reduced by 30% except incendiary weapons.
sco1.enemyDesc: He runs Port de Nuit from the shadows.

sco2.personality: Seductive, manipulative, deadly charming. He knows everyone's secrets.
sco2.motivation: Information is his power. Scotty uses him as a high-society spy network.
sco2.backstory: A former luxury-station gigolo turned master spy. Scotty saw his potential when he learned the Shadow Master had ended three political marriages in a week — just for sport. Now he listens, he records, and he sells. To Scotty first.
sco2.combatMechanic: Turns your weapons against you: 25% chance your attack hits you instead. Immune to confusion effects.
sco2.specialAbility: Mirror — 25% chance your attacks are reflected back.
sco2.enemyDesc: The secrets he holds are worth armies.

sco3.personality: Prophetic, condescending, terrifying. He claims to see the future — and he's often right.
sco3.motivation: Maintain his influence over the elite. Scotty protects him because his predictions are good for the casino.
sco3.backstory: A former AI researcher turned self-proclaimed oracle. His predictive ability isn't mystical — it's a network of sensors and algorithms he's hidden throughout La Couronne. He knows what you're going to do before you do.
sco3.combatMechanic: Predicts your attacks: automatically dodges the same attack type used the previous turn. Forces you to vary your approach.
sco3.specialAbility: Prediction — immune to the same attack type twice in a row.
sco3.enemyDesc: He predicts your movements. He's already seen them.

sco4.personality: Calm. Terrifying precisely because he's calm. Nothing surprises him, nothing makes him react.
sco4.motivation: Carry out a dead man's last wish. The Abyss holds something Scotty wants — and Pale guards it.
sco4.backstory: A former director of a research station gone wrong. The station fell into the Abyss, but Pale stayed. What he saw down there changed him. He no longer blinks. He no longer sleeps. He no longer eats. And yet he's still there.
sco4.combatMechanic: The more you hit him, the more dangerous he becomes: +10% damage per 20% HP lost.
sco4.specialAbility: Silent rage — his damage increases as he loses HP.

informantLines: A stranger approaches you between corridors. "I heard about what you're looking for," he says quietly, before vanishing into the crowd.
A hooded figure slips you a quick word, almost a whisper, then disappears before you can react.
Someone recognizes your badge and pulls you aside. "You're hunting a lieutenant, aren't you? I might have something for you."
An old contact resurfaces, as if out of nowhere. "Still after that lieutenant? Listen closely, I won't repeat this."
